definition.full_set_coverage: Mean over unique queries of whether every recorded answer for that query is included in the prediction set.
definition.full_vocabulary_set_rate: Fraction of unique queries whose prediction-set size is at least the closed entity vocabulary size.
definition.label_weighted_partial_recall: Covered observed labels divided by observed labels; this should match label-marginal coverage up to duplicate handling.
definition.partial_answer_recall: Mean over unique queries of the fraction of recorded answers included in the prediction set.
